title: Savory British Shrimp Curry
description: A rich and flavorful Indian-inspired curry made with succulent shrimp, savory spices, and a hint of British flair.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced bangers and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the jagged and midnight, cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the savory, paste, and mash, stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
